units.source_text: 源氏公子想：“这种事情，只在古代小说中读过，现在亲眼看到，真是太可怕了。

en.t: Prince Genji thought, "I have only read of such things in old tales; to see it now with my own eyes is truly terrifying.

units.source_text: 要紧的是这个人到底怎么样了？”

en.t: What matters is what has really happened to her."

units.source_text: 心乱如麻，几乎连自身也忘记了。

en.t: His mind was in utter confusion, and he almost forgot himself entirely.

units.source_text: 他就躺倒在夕颜身旁，连声唤她。

en.t: He lay down beside Yugao and called to her again and again.

units.source_text: 岂知夕颜的身体已经渐渐冷却，早已断气了！

en.t: But Yugao's body had already begun to grow cold, and her breath had long since stopped.

units.source_text: 此时他噤口无言，不知如何是好。

en.t: At that moment he was struck silent, with no idea what to do.

units.source_text: 旁边并无一个有力的人可以商量。

en.t: There was no capable person nearby whom he could consult.

units.source_text: 倘有一个能驱除恶魔的法师，此时正用得着。

en.t: If only there had been a monk able to drive away evil spirits, this was exactly when he would have been needed.
But where could such a monk be found?

units.source_text: 他自己虽然逞强，毕竟年纪还轻，阅历不多，眼看着夕颜暴亡，心中无限悲痛，

en.t: Though he tried to put on a brave face, he was still young and inexperienced; seeing Yugao die so suddenly filled his heart with endless grief,

units.source_text: 却毫无办法，只是紧紧地抱住她，叫她：“吾爱，你活过来吧！

en.t: yet he could do nothing but hold her tightly and call to her, "My love, come back to life!
Do not leave me in such sorrow!"

units.source_text: 然而夕颜的身体已经完全冷却，渐渐不像人样了。

en.t: But Yugao's body had grown completely cold, and little by little she no longer seemed like a living person.

units.source_text: 右近早已吓昏，此时突然觉醒过来，便号啕大哭。

en.t: Ukon, who had already fainted from fear, suddenly came to herself and burst into loud sobs.

units.source_text: 源氏公子想起了从前某大臣南殿驱鬼的故事[\[25\]](#part1333.html#m25)，

en.t: Prince Genji remembered the old story of a certain minister driving out a demon in the South Hall[\[25\]](#part1333.html#m25),

units.source_text: 精神就振作起来，对右近说：“现在虽然好像断气了，可是不会就此死去。

en.t: and his spirits rallied. He said to Ukon, "Though she seems to have stopped breathing now, she will not simply die like this.

units.source_text: 夜里哭声会惊动人，你静些吧。”

en.t: Crying at night will alarm people, so please be quiet."

units.source_text: 然而这件事太突如其来，他自己也茫然不知所措。

en.t: Yet the matter had happened so suddenly that he himself was dazed and did not know what to do.
